text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having produced results in the Satsuki 
Sho, Eishin Flash gears up for the Japan 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the gap in recognition between 
her and the other Umamusume only widened. 
What she came up with to close that gap 
was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To gain "experience" by running simulated 
races of the same intensity as the real 
thing every single week. However, it was 
an approach that placed far too heavy a 
burden on the body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer now has to think of a way to 
gain the desired "experience" without 
overdoing it—
